Name: Jobab, Son of Joktan
Summary: Jobab was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Eber, in the line of Shem.
KeyStory: Jobab is the last of Joktan's sons named in the Table of Nations.
RelatedPeople: Joktan; Ophir; Havilah, Son of Joktan
LifeLesson: God's promise to fill the earth moved forward through families like this one.
